1. (Currently Amended) A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein __the first sensor is in direct contact with the first battery cell or the enclosure__.

2. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising an adhesive layer positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect deformation or swelling of the first battery cell__.

3. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor generates an output signal responsive to mechanical stress applied by the first battery cell__.

4. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 3, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane, __and wherein the first sensor output signal indicates a degree of force or pressure exerted by the first battery cell__.

5. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell, __such that the first sensor is responsive to lateral expansion of the first battery cell__.

6. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces transmitted through the adhesive layer__.

7. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a deformable element positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor detects deformation of the deformable element caused by the first battery cell__.

8. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises an enclosure portion of protective film; and the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the enclosure portion, __and wherein the first sensor is in contact with the protective film__.

9. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 8, wherein the protective film is a polyester film, __and wherein the first sensor detects forces transmitted through the polyester film__.

10. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises a plastic case portion; and the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the plastic case portion, __and wherein the first sensor is in contact with the plastic case portion__.

11. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces between the stacked battery cells__.

12. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising an adhesive layer between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __wherein the first sensor detects forces transmitted through the adhesive layer__.

13. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor generates an output signal responsive to mechanical stress applied between the stacked cells__.

14. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 13, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane, __and wherein the first sensor output signal indicates a degree of force or pressure exerted between the stacked battery cells__.

15. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell, __such that the first sensor is responsive to lateral expansion between the stacked battery cells__.

16. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces transmitted through the adhesive layer between the stacked cells__.

17. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, __wherein the first sensor and second sensor are each configured to independently detect deformation or swelling of their respective battery cells__.

18. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 17 further comprising a processor configured to: receive a first sensor output signal from the first sensor; receive a second sensor output signal from the second sensor; conduct an evaluation based at least on the received output signals __to determine whether deformation or swelling has occurred in the first battery cell or the third battery cell__; and generate at least one processor output signal based on the evaluation.

19. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to alter an operation of the third battery cell independently from an operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the processor determines which battery cell to alter based on which sensor detected a force condition__.

20. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to turn off the third battery cell and to maintain operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the processor selectively disables the third battery cell in response to the second sensor detecting a force condition__.

21. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material, __and wherein the force sensing material is positioned in direct contact with the first battery cell or the enclosure__.

22. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 21, wherein the force sensing material comprises at least one variable electrical conductor, __wherein the variable electrical conductor changes conductance in response to mechanical deformation__.

23. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a first level of electrical conductance when the at least one variable electrical conductor is quiescent, and wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a second level of conductance when a mechanical stress is applied to the at least one variable electrical conductor, __and wherein the second level of conductance is measurably different from the first level__.

24. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor is a quantum tunneling composite, __and wherein the quantum tunneling composite exhibits increased conductance upon application of mechanical force__.

25. (Cancelled)

26. (Cancelled)

27. (Cancelled)

28. (Original) A method for monitoring a battery comprising a first cell and a second cell stacked within an enclosure, the method comprising: positioning a first sensor material between the first cell and one of the second cell and the enclosure; varying the conductance of the first material based on at least one force influencing the first cell; and producing a first force output signal based on the conductance of the first material.

29. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising controlling a facility of the first cell based on the force output signal.

30. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising: receiving a battery status signal, wherein the battery status signal is responsive to at least one of a voltage, a current, and a temperature of the first cell; evaluating the first force output signal and the battery status signal; and generating at least one evaluated output signal based on the evaluation of the first force output signal and the battery status signal.
